tickets.what: docs/neon-proposal/09-split-tests-for-parallel-speed.md S1: tests/helpers/thin-mcp-harness.mjs plus the ten tests/unit/thin-mcp-*.test.mjs files; delete tests/unit/thin-mcp.test.mjs. Pure move: every existing test case kept with its body unchanged (count them before and after; the sonic count was 158 top-level test( calls / 162 fixture uses), no production code change. Line refs in the proposal drift; check against the current file.

acceptance.text: Same number of test cases before and after; none skipped or merged

tickets.what: Proposal 09 S2: tests/helpers/thin-mcp-fake-bin.mjs and thin-mcp-clock.mjs; harness shrinks; role-places.test.mjs drops its duplicate fixture (it spans :22-79 now); package.json gains test:mcp, test:panel, test:fast. Existing test, test:unit, test:mjs scripts unchanged.

tickets.title: Shorten long fixed waits with test-only timing overrides
tickets.what: Proposal 09 S3 with owner defaults Q1=A (optional params / HUD_* env overrides, production defaults byte-identical) and Q2=A (panel-backoff's 27 s case stays in the default suite, scaled through configurable refreshMs/max): src/cli/watch.ts, src/utils/panel-reload.ts, packages/hud-mcp/bin/hud-watch.mjs, src/collectors/adaptive-poll.ts; split panel-reload.test.mjs and job-retention.test.mjs; retime panel-backoff, hud-watch and thin-mcp-* tests.

acceptance.text: Production defaults unchanged when no override is set (a test asserts it)
test:mjs green three runs in a row; wall time reported
